Acknowledgment with Admin rights (e.g., corresponding warning, alarm)

Allows the PLC to give the operator access rights. The rights group (Setter, Operator, Admin) in effect is set via the protectionPlcLogon object. If ACCESS = 1, the operator can use these rights (does not have to register separately), when ACCESS = 0, this corresponds to a logoff.

Bit AUTO must be set (Byte 1.4 = 1) when the measurement program should be switched on using the PLC fieldbus. With AUTO = 1, the PLC has full control over maXYmo. A manual setup is thus also blocked!
